title: CCP receiver-aware revision and conformance
description: Implement and verify the user-approved receiver-aware CCP revision across Python, Rust and C/Zephyr. Canonical policy separates stable receiver rendezvous, directional link-budget PHY selection and airtime admission; removes density-driven CH0 fallback/SF escalation; preserves fixed scheduled SF10 profile01, legal/adaptive ceilings, bounded queues and best-effort custody. Incorporate conventional-LoRa full-band channel-plan representation and qualification without asserting regulatory/grant approval. Spec, independent wire/policy oracles, production integration, joined conformance/compliance tests and evidence documentation must precede completion. Existing primitives and gap beads are reused; old threshold-based closure notes do not establish revised conformance.
notes: 2026-09-09: User explicitly approved promoting proposal worker6-5qtu.2 into specification and requested Beads for implementation, spec conformance/compliance tests and docs. Also requested incorporating docs/speculation-and-futurism.md, wider US915 plans and SX1262 narrow-band/amateur experimentation. Wideband/narrow-band capability, regulatory enforcement and equipment authorization are distinct. No experimental RF plan is activated by this approval. No source code or hardware work is claimed complete by the spec revision.
